title: FACS Sorting of Fluorescent Bodo Cells
author: Zhu-Hong Li

steps.title: Prepare FACS Sheath Fluid
steps.instruction: Prepare a diluted sheath fluid suitable for B. saltans survival and FACS functionality.

substeps.instruction: Dilute standard sheath fluid to 40% concentration.

steps.title: Isolate Wild Type B. saltans Population
steps.instruction: Filter and wash wild type cultures to identify the B. saltans population.

substeps.instruction: Pass wild type cultures through a 10 nm Nylon filter to remove large residues.
Collect filtered cells by centrifugation at 1,200 x g for 5 minutes.
Wash cells three times by centrifugation at 1,200 x g for 5 minutes.
Wash cells twice more at 1,200 x g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cells in culture medium.

steps.title: Identify B. saltans via FACS
steps.instruction: Use size and shape parameters to isolate and confirm the B. saltans population.

substeps.instruction: Sort cells by size and shape into collection tubes using 40% standard sheath fluid.
Analyze the SSC vs FSC dot plot to identify the B. saltans population (R1).
Confirm the identity of population 1 as B. saltans using microscopy.

steps.title: Prepare Transfected B. saltans for Sorting
steps.instruction: Process wild type and transfected B. saltans cells following electroporation.

substeps.instruction: Filter cells through a 10 nm Nylon membrane 24 hours after electroporation.
Collect cells by centrifugation at 1,000 x g for 5 minutes.
Wash cells twice with autoclaved distilled water.
Resuspend cells in approximately 1-1.5 ml medium.
Prepare a collection tube containing 2 ml fresh culture medium.

steps.title: Set FACS Sorting Parameters
steps.instruction: Establish sorting gates using wild type control cells.

substeps.instruction: Run wild type control cells through the sorter.
Select the B. saltans population in the SSC vs FSC dot plot.
Set the gate in the fluorescence plot using the DsRed vs GFP dot plot (confirming no cells are in the gated area for wild type cells).

steps.title: Sort Fluorescent B. saltans Cells
steps.instruction: Isolate the reporter-gene-positive population from transfected cells.

substeps.instruction: Run the transfected B. saltans through the sorter.
Identify the small population of fluorescent cells in the fluorescence plot.
Sort the fluorescent population into the collection tube.

steps.title: Recover Sorted Cells
steps.instruction: Transfer sorted cells to culture for growth.

substeps.instruction: Transfer sorted cells from the collection tube to a T25 flask.
Add 4 ml culture medium.
Add a small colony of bacteria taken from a plate.

description: Introduction: Fluorescence-activated cell sorting (FACS) is a powerful method to isolate cells expressing fluorescent proteins. It is a routine technique in our lab to enrich, and subclone cells that express exogenously introduced fluorescent reporter proteins. We developed this protocol to isolate Bodo saltans that express a fluorescent protein.
